name: The Connector
fieldReading: Every stranger is a line waiting to be drawn.
bio: A closer of gaps, forever splicing new lines between strangers who were always meant to meet.
sceneStory: On a dark plain between two far hills, each crowned by a single lonely star, a figure holds a glowing thread pulled down from each one. They twist the two ends together and the join flares white, a taut line of light snapping into place between the two stars.
assignments: Introduce two friends who have never met.
Every stranger is a line not yet lit.
